name: VolMan
tagline: Native APFS Volume Analyzer, External Offload, Archive & Git Worktree Suite
short_description: Native macOS APFS drive analyzer with symlink & clone deduplication, non-blocking Git & worktree manager, direct-streaming compressed backup & archive builder, external storage offload planner, cloud storage hydration guard, 3-column storage flow map, and Low Effort Suite theme & Dock icon sync.
spotlight_description: VolMan 1.0 brings precision APFS & external drive telemetry to macOS. Inspect mounted volumes with symlink & APFS clone deduplication, manage Git repositories and linked worktrees non-blockingly, stream compressed .tar.gz/.zip archives directly to external drives while reclaiming local SSD space, offload heavy folders with transparent symlinks, guard against unwanted CloudStorage hydration (iCloud, OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox), and sync themes & persistent Dock icons across PerfMon, EventViewer, and VolMan.
catalog_description: Native macOS APFS volume analyzer, Git worktree manager, external storage offload planner, compressed backup archive builder, and smart cleanup suite engineered in Swift 6. Features symlink & APFS clone deduplication, Spotlight clone overcount prevention, non-blocking Git worktree discovery & pruning, direct-streaming .tar.gz/.zip archives with automatic local SSD reclamation, default-off CloudStorage provider tree guards, 3-column Storage Flow Map, 8-style desktop HUD Cards, and Low Effort Suite theme & Dock icon sync.
spotlight_chips: Low Effort Suite Theme & Icon Sync
